title: chamaefistula caudata
intro: Chamaefistula caudata, commonly known as Bushy Kola, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in African folk medicine for its medicinal properties. Chamaefistula caudata is known to have several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
